branch.definition: A woody part growing from a tree.

medallion.definition: A large medal kept as a special object.

bookmark.definition: Something used to mark a place in a book.

rattled.definition: Made a series of short knocking sounds.

pyramid.definition: An ancient structure with triangular sides meeting at the top.

desert.definition: A very dry area with little rain.

mummy.definition: A body preserved and wrapped in cloth.

ghost.definition: The spirit of a dead person in a story.

queen.definition: A woman who rules a country.

torch.definition: A burning stick used to give light.

tomb.definition: A place where a dead person is buried.

hieroglyphs.definition: Ancient writing made with pictures and symbols.

scroll.definition: A long roll of paper used for writing.

shadows.definition: Dark shapes made when something blocks light.

passage.definition: A narrow way through a building.

chamber.definition: A room inside a large building or structure.

sarcophagus.definition: A stone container for a coffin.

treasure.definition: Valuable objects such as gold and jewels.
